g1.flow: Two warnings back to back, after 'that over which they are in disagreement'. The first is bare: kallā sayaʿlamūn. The second adds thumma ('then') and leads straight into 'Have We not made the earth a resting place?'. Hook: say it once, then thumma, say it again.

cues.78:4: 1st, no thumma: right after 'that over which they are in disagreement'.
cues.78:5: 2nd, opens with thumma; next, the earth made a resting place.

g2.flow: Same opening, lā yasmaʿūna fīhā laghwan wa lā, then a different last word. Al-Wāqiʿah ends taʾthīmā (sin), after 'reward for what they used to do', then 'peace, peace'. An-Nabaʾ ends kidhdhābā (falsehood), after 'a full cup', then 'reward from your Lord'. Hook: kidhdhābā sounds like mukadhdhibīn, the deniers of Al-Mursalāt just before.

cues.56:25: Al-Wāqiʿah: ends taʾthīmā (sin); after 'reward for what they used to do'.
cues.78:35: An-Nabaʾ: ends kidhdhābā (falsehood); after 'a full cup', then reward from your Lord.
